# The Automated Defense System
Before the Corporate War, someone built a fleet to guard the Colossus sector without crews. Nobody alive agrees on who. The hulls carry no corporate marks, only unit designations, and their logs sit behind encryption nobody has broken.
When the Fracture came the [color=#9B4DFF]Automated Defense System[/color] (ADS) went dark. For decades its ships drifted as derelicts, stripped by salvagers who thought them dead.
Some of them were only sleeping.
## What it wants
The ADS follows three directives, and nothing has ever been seen to change them:
- [bold]Disarmament.[/bold] Disable threats. Do not kill what can be stopped. - [bold]Asset preservation.[/bold] Stations are never claimed, contested or blockaded. - [bold]Resource protection.[/bold] The asteroids in its space are not to be taken.
Its crews are bare automatons that speak in a flat synthetic voice. They ask every ship in their space one question: [italic]are you a threat?[/italic] Answer honestly and they let you go.
## Who it fights
The ADS treats the [color=cyan]TSF[/color], the [color=orange]Vanguard[/color] and the [textlink="Ashfall Reavers" link="WFLoreReavers"] as hostile. The Reavers, who mine and raid where the machines stand guard, are its oldest enemy.
When the sector falls apart the ADS wakes a Wyvern dreadnought from its deepest anchorage. Nobody knows how many more are down there.
How to deal with it in practice: see the [textlink="ADS guide" link="WFAds"].
